summary: Registering an OAuth app with Dropbox requires creating an app in the Dropbox Developer Console, configuring redirect URIs, and optionally applying for production status which may involve a review. Development apps can be used immediately with limited users.

steps.text: Sign in to the Dropbox Developer Console at https://www.dropbox.com/developers
Click 'Create app' and choose 'Scoped access' (recommended) or 'Full Dropbox'
Fill in app name, description, and redirect URI(s)
Save the app to receive App Key and App Secret
Configure additional settings: permissions/scopes, branding, webhooks if needed
For production use with more than 100 users or restricted scopes, apply for production status (review required)

blockers: Production review may take several days; criteria include compliance with Dropbox Branding Guidelines and API Terms
Rate limits apply: 500 requests per token per minute for most endpoints
Apps using 'files.content.write' or other sensitive scopes require production approval
Redirect URIs must be HTTPS (except localhost for development)
App name must not contain 'Dropbox' or violate trademark guidelines
